title: Claim a Voucher for a Free Game of Colour Grid @ Timezone (App Required)
body:
Deal: Claim a Voucher for a Free Game of Colour Grid @ Timezone (App Required)

[Poison Ivy] This shit cost $8 per person (so $16) at my local Timezone….
[King Steuart] Imagine paying $8pp for your family to play a fun game like this and then having twelvies leaning on the sides tapping the red blocks… Can't say I didn't rage at them
[87percent] For those that couldn’t find it, it’s the barcode thing at the top (and then enter the code manually)
[knobbs] Pretty weird you have to go into the app to claim the code to get a code to show the staff to claim the game
[bcYield] I think they want you to use the app at least at the time of claiming by touching the app here and there to produce a unique code. I guess showing to the staff to make it hard for the multiple account abuser.
[s0805] Once redeemed in App, how long you to use the offer?
[conant] I saw a father leading 8 kids playing the game the other day. It looks fun. I think it is charged per game, regardless number of players?
[bluepop] We played. It is so fun. And it makes a video of you
[cooni] Anyone know what the in store redemption process is like after you have the code in the app?
[bcYield] The other day I was accidentally watching someone and someone playing for the whole game…
